Write a synthetic recording (noise, line noise, drifting units)

```text
dspk generate [OPTIONS] <OUTPUT>
```

**Arguments**

- **`<OUTPUT>`**  
  Output file (bin) or folder (zarr)

**Options**

- **`-c, --channels <CHANNELS>`**: default `384`
- **`-d, --duration <DURATION>`**: default `1`  
  Length: seconds, or with a unit (90s, 10m, 2h)
- **`-r, --sample-rate <SAMPLE_RATE>`**: default `30000`  
  Sample rate (Hz)
- **`--noise <NOISE>`**: default `15`  
  White Gaussian noise, RMS (µV)
- **`--line-noise <LINE_NOISE>`**: default `25`  
  Power-line interference amplitude (µV)
- **`--units <UNITS>`**  
  Simulated units (default: one per 4 channels, at most 64); 0 for noise only
- **`-f, --format <FORMAT>`**
  - `bin`: Flat binary + JSON `.meta` sidecar
  - `zarr`: Chunked Zarr v3 store (float32)
- **`--dtype <DTYPE>`**: default `float32`, one of `float32`, `int16`  
  Stored sample type (bin)
- **`--order <ORDER>`**  
  Memory order (bin)
  - `channel-major`
  - `time-major`: Interleaved frames, as acquisition systems write
- **`--step <STEP>`**: default `0.195`  
  µV per stored step (bin, int16)
